About / 关于

Hello, I am Hisey.

你好，我是陈浩曦。

I am Hisey Chen, a second-year Interaction Design student at Emily Carr University of Art + Design. My practice spans service design, interface design, wayfinding and spatial experience. I am interested in how people understand information, navigate environments and interact with complex systems.

陈浩曦，Hisey，现就读于 Emily Carr University of Art + Design 交互设计专业二年级。我的实践涵盖服务设计、界面设计、导视标识与空间体验。我关注数字界面、公共空间与信息系统之间的关系，并通过清晰的视觉语言与系统化设计，改善人们理解信息、使用服务和探索环境的方式。
